Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

You will be part of an international team, driving the development of 1GLOBAL's eSIM platform, including our consumer and IoT solutions. We are looking for a talented developer and team player, capable of handling architectural and technical specifications, designing and implementing new services, maintaining existing components, and testing our applications.
The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build high impact features and contribute to the architecture design; aim towards resiliency, scalability, security and fault tolerance;
  • Advocate for high code quality, readability and high tests coverage;
  • Promote best practices for a high-scale web (or mobile) environment;
  • Work with an Agile methodology;
  • Identify areas of improvement in the codebase and promote them through seamless integrations, documenting solutions and new flows;
  • Mentor junior members when needed and contribute with meaningful reviews.
  • 4+ years of experience in Java software development;
  • Experience with unit/integration/e2e testing (test-driven development is a plus);
  • Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming the interfaces;
  • Experience with development tools and processes (Git-flow, peer reviewing);
  • Familiarity with relational databases, CI/CD flows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes;
  • Good understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure;
  • Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with a self-motivated and autonomous mindset.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Em nossa empresa oferecemos, investimos no crescimento dos nossos colaboradores com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira.
Se você está pronto para assumir um papel essencial, onde seu trabalho será valorizado e terá um impacto positivo na segurança e tranquilidade de muitos, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe de vigilantes. Aqui, seu crescimento profissional é nossa prioridade.
Não perca a chance de integrar uma equipe dedicada e crescer em um ambiente que valoriza o seu potencial. Junte-se a nós e comece uma jornada de sucesso como vigilante!
Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e contar com seu talento em nossa equipe.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Garantir a segurança e a proteção do patrimônio, dos colaboradores e dos visitantes, monitorando e prevenindo atividades suspeitas ou ilegais, assegurando a ordem e o cumprimento das normas internas.

  • Realizar rondas periódicas nas instalações para prevenir e detectar sinais de intrusão, roubo, vandalismo ou outras atividades ilegais.
  • Controlar e registrar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos e materiais nas dependências dos clientes.
  • Controlar a entrada de visitantes e prestadores de serviços, garantindo que estejam devidamente cadastrados e acompanhados.
  • Identificar e relatar situações de risco ou condições inseguras, tomando ações preventivas para evitar acidentes ou incidentes.
  • Atuar de forma rápida e eficiente em situações de contingência, como incêndios, acidentes ou invasões, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Colaborar com as forças de segurança pública em casos de crimes ou distúrbios.
  • Manter registros precisos de atividades diárias, incidentes, ocorrências e outras informações relevantes.
  • Preencher relatórios de ocorrência e comunicar aos superiores sobre quaisquer incidentes significativos.
  • Oferecer atendimento cordial e profissional aos colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, fornecendo informações e orientações quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar na organização e controle de eventos internos.

O vigilante é responsável por garantir a segurança e integridade das instalações e pessoas, prevenindo ações criminosas e respondendo prontamente a contingências. Este profissional deve ser atento, proativo e capaz de atuar de forma eficaz em situações de risco.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Curso de formação de vigilante com reciclagem em dia.
  • Experiência prévia na área de segurança patrimonial ou funções similares.
  • Conhecimento básico em informática e sistemas de vigilância eletrônica.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em turnos, incluindo noites, fins de semana e feriados.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações de stress e tomar decisões rápidas.

Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical es una empresa de software global, editora de Ubuntu y soluciones empresariales de código abierto para la nube, desarrolladores, IoT e IA. Ubuntu es la distribución de Linux de más rápido crecimiento y se posiciona como el sistema operativo número uno en la nube.

En colaboración con Google, Amazon, IBM y Microsoft, Canonical ayuda a las empresas a ser más ágiles, productivas y a adoptar nuevas tecnologías rápidamente. Ejemplos de éxito incluyen proyectos en IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma preferida para el desarrollo.

El papel de un representante de desarrollo de ventas en Canonical

Canonical es rentable y está en crecimiento. Consideramos que nuestro equipo de desarrollo de ventas es uno de los mejores en el mercado tecnológico, seleccionando candidatos excepcionales y ambiciosos. Disfrutarás este rol si eres organizado, persistente, carismático y trabajador, con interés en la tecnología y sus aplicaciones comerciales. Colaborarás con equipos regionales de ventas y marketing, con el objetivo principal de identificar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestros productos y promover la marca Canonical en diversas industrias y regiones.

Cómo será tu día

  • Atender consultas entrantes de clientes vía email, teléfono y chat.
  • Ejecutar campañas de ventas y marketing salientes.

Lo que buscamos en ti

  • Excelentes resultados académicos en escuela y universidad.
  • Pasión por los negocios y la tecnología.
  • Compromiso con el aprendizaje y la mejora continua: curioso, flexible y analítico.
  • Capacidad para resolver problemas creativamente y colaborar en equipo.
  • Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
  • Orientación a resultados y espíritu de superación.
  • Persistencia y perseverancia.

Qué te ofrecemos

El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar justicia y equidad a nivel global.

Entre los beneficios adicionales se incluyen:

  • Presupuesto anual de USD 2000 para desarrollo personal y aprendizaje.
  • Revisión salarial anual.
  • Programas de reconocimiento y recompensas.
  • Vacaciones anuales.
  • Licencia parental.
  • Programa de asistencia al empleado.
  • Oportunidades de viaje para conocer colegas en "sprints".
  • Priority Pass y mejoras en viajes para eventos corporativos de larga distancia.

Canonical promueve igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos un ambiente inclusivo donde todos sean considerados sin discriminación, independientemente de su identidad o antecedentes.

Job description

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Consórcio

Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same

Conheça sua missão:

  2. Garante que todos os pedidos sejam separados dentro dos prazos estipulados, validando-os no sistema para a posterior emissão da nota fiscal. Possui conhecimento em roteirização, monitora o processo de carregamento e verifica que todos os pedidos programados para o dia estejam prontos e a caminho do cliente;
  3. Acompanha as demandas registradas pelo Centro de Serviço ao Cliente (CSN), incluindo reposições e coletas solicitadas. Está ciente dos relatórios e indicadores da área, embora possa necessitar de orientação adicional para uma compreensão mais aprofundada;
  4. Direcionar os colaboradores encarregados das separações utilizando o painel de controle de separação e o sistema SAP, garantindo que sejam concluídas dentro do prazo estipulado para entrega;
  5. Realiza a gestão dos casos de furo de estoque e o diagnóstico das questões por meio do dashboard, propondo medidas de aprimoramento na área de atuação. Conduz todos os procedimentos internos pertinentes às devoluções;
  6. Demonstra autonomia e tem habilidade no processo de distribuição de pedidos e assume a responsabilidade pela organização do pátio, orientando a equipe quando necessário;
  7. Assegura tanto a produtividade quanto a satisfação dos clientes no que tange ao processo de retirada de mercadorias, e mantém um controle rigoroso dos pedidos relacionados à expedição e retirada, garantindo que sejam entregues dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  8. Realiza a interpretação de dados do dashboard, sendo capaz de se adaptar a situações complexas e aprimorar processos existentes de maneira eficaz. Conduz de forma autônoma as situações de furo de estoque, colaborando diretamente com o gestor para resolvê-las;
  9. Participa das reuniões de briefing, identificando na logística áreas que requerem melhorias, propondo ideias para aumentar a eficiência dos separadores, e fornece orientação e direcionamento a equipe de forma eficiente;
  10. Realiza acompanhamentos de furos de estoque e inventários rotativos, produz relatórios de inventários, contribuindo de maneira significativa para a compreensão e superação dos desafios relacionados à redução de demarca;
  11. Executa a gestão de estoque, validando as faltas de estoque e quaisquer discrepâncias identificadas, monitorando de perto o indicador de demarca, promovendo e realizando os ajustes quando necessário;
  12. Atua como multiplicador no processo de gestão de estoque dentro da sua unidade, assumindo a responsabilidade de ser o zelador de todos os procedimentos relacionados a gestão de estoque, e apoia ativamente a área de Supply no desenvolvimento de relatórios relacionados à gestão de estoque;
  13. Garantir a execução dos inventários, tanto sistêmicos quanto físicos evitando erros de contagens e ajustes;
  14. Notifica a equipe de cadastro sempre que há a necessidade de atualizar informações cadastrais dos materiais, identificadas durante o processo de conferência, contribuindo para a conclusão tranquila do processo de recebimento, sem contratempos;
  15. Executa a liberação de canhotos de todas as notas recebidas, certificando que os processos foram concluídas com sucesso. Certifica-se de que todas as notas recebidas foram processadas com sucesso ao término do expediente. Realiza o arquivamento de documentos fiscais de maneira eficiente e organizada;
  16. Notifica os fornecedores que não cumpriram com as normas internas de segurança e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  17. Colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelando pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, mantendo atualizada a planilha de controles de pallets e resíduos, e realizando as auditorias dos mesmos;
  18. Manter atualizado os lançamentos de FreteFob e fornecer total suporte para solucionar pendencias de pagamentos;
  19. Realizar o controle do depósito de recebimento, assegurando a atualização constante e evitando a estagnação de produtos por mais de 24 horas;
  20. Efetua o controle de notas de devoluções aos fornecedores e mantém a comunicação ativa para soluções de abatimento, realiza a criação de DTs de forma correta evitando que NFs fiquem sem lançamentos, e executa o processo de estorno fazendo o acompanhamentos até a etapa final do processo;
  21. Apoia no controle dos insumos da seção.

Para fazer parte do nosso time você deve ter:

As sementes da Syngenta melhoram a qualidade e o rendimento das culturas. Sementes de alta qualidade garantem colheitas melhores e mais produtivas, razão pela qual os agricultores investem nelas. As sementes avançadas ajudam a mitigar riscos como doenças e secas e permitem que os agricultores cultivem alimentos usando menos terra, menos água e menos insumos.

A Syngenta Seeds traz aos agricultores plantas mais vigorosas, fortes e resistentes, incluindo variedades híbridas inovadoras e culturas biotecnológicas que podem prosperar mesmo em condições de cultivo desafiadoras.

title: Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience
description:
Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience

At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. We act intentionally to ensure our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. We recognize our responsibility and need for change, understanding that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’. Our affinity groups are built from volunteers from different businesses and actively participate in defining our DE&I strategies. They act as ambassadors of this agenda and will support you from Day1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.
For millions of customers worldwide, the Amazon name is synonymous with delivery – and the Delivery Experience (DEX) team provides those customers with innovative ways to get what they want and need, enabling the choices they make on every order, every day. We combine customer impact with retail invention, solving huge technical challenges along the way.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon.com.br is an important and fast-growing business for Amazon.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead Delivery Experience Regionalization. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining high-impact processes and supporting teams that help us deliver on our customer promise seamlessly. This role will partner closely with Amazon Transportation, Operations, Finance, Retail, and WW DEX leadership to solve customer-facing shipping solutions.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Define and deliver important programs with broad cross-functional and cross-organizational business impact.
  2. Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of a highly complicated cross-functional project in a new business area.
  3. Delivery strategy: work closely with team leadership to define priorities for delivery strategy internally and with partners, using data to create and communicate business plans to senior leadership.
  4. Product Definition: incorporate benchmarking information from local competitors as well as best practices and lessons learned from other geographies to define best-in-class customer experience.
  5. Support and own the design and development of projects, working through all related dependencies with internal and external teams, mainly Operations, Transportation, Buyer Risk Prevention, and Technology teams.
  6. Develop customer requirements (user stories, use cases) and business requirements, participating in the design of the user experience, release goals, and prioritization of assigned features according to customer value.
  7. Bring strong, data-driven business and strategic judgment to decisions.
  8. Develop business and process requirements, prioritize needs, and manage milestones and overall roadmap.
  9. Enhance Amazon delivery experience, including the definition of shipping prices and shipping promotions.
  10. Bring analytical horsepower, enhanced Excel skills (and ideally SQL), and a deep curiosity about how things work.
  11. Identify and develop opportunities for improved cash flow in Shipping Programs.
  12. Engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3-year strategy, and outlook.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Relevant years of product or program management, product marketing, business development, or technology experience.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.
- Experience with end-to-end product delivery.
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product.
- Experience as a product manager or owner.
- Experience owning technology products.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights.
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders.

Referência em saúde, destaque em gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, dedicado às melhores práticas sustentáveis e atuante nas comunidades onde está presente, o Grupo Sabin nasceu na capital federal, fruto da coragem e determinação de duas empreendedoras, Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, em 1984. Hoje conta com cerca de 7000 colaboradores unidos pelo propósito de inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas.

Presente em 14 estados, além do Distrito Federal, a empresa oferece serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental às 354 unidades distribuídas de norte a sul do país.

O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra um portfólio de negócios que contempla análises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo. Além disso, contempla também serviços de atenção primária, contribuindo para a gestão de saúde de grupos populacionais por meio de programas e linhas de cuidados coordenados, com a Amparo Saúde, e a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde - Rita Saúde - solução digital que conta com diversos parceiros como farmácias, médicos e outros profissionais, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência.

Com o objetivo de fomentar o empreendedorismo na saúde, o Grupo lançou, em 2020, o SkyHub.Bio, um hub de inovação que atua na promoção e no desenvolvimento de startups, estimulando parcerias, troca de conhecimento e a construção de modelos de negócio que contribuam para o setor de saúde com base na ciência, eficiência e experiência do cliente.

Como uma empresa nacional sólida, visionária, com valores bem estabelecidos, comprometida com uma agenda ESG de forma genuína e serviços de saúde e bem-estar para apoiar a jornada de saúde de seus clientes, de Norte a Sul do país, o Grupo Sabin é mantenedor do Instituto Sabin, que desde 2005 trabalha ações de impacto social nas comunidades onde a empresa está presente, com foco na melhoria da qualidade de vida, do bem-estar e da prosperidade dessas comunidades, fomentando a inovação social. Nessa trajetória o Instituto impactou positivamente a vida de mais de 1,6 milhões de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais.

Conheça nossos processos seletivos, fique por dentro das vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin espalhadas por todo Brasil. Afinal, investimos em processos formulados para trazer para o nosso Grupo pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores.

title: Senior Developer
description:
Description

ADP is hiring a Senior Developer – Celergo Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

As a Senior Developer, you are an innovative thinker with a "can-do" attitude. You will work with teams across the company to leverage technologies that support our backend applications. Your work can include new features, enhancements, and resolving defects for frontend and backend solutions. Those things are important because our products impact people's lives.

Every day, you'll be coding and asking questions that clarify scalability and user challenges. You will be part of an Agile environment working with a team of talented engineers, product owners, and stakeholders continually developing, deploying, and testing application software.

To be successful in this role, you must know how to create functional, maintainable, and scalable code in an object-oriented fashion. You have real-world experience solving business problems and thrive in a fast-paced, Agile environment where you can quickly change direction when needed. You are happy to do hands-on coding and development in .NET alongside a team of coders. Your experience allows you to act as a mentor to junior developers. Our best leaders are great communicators and passionate creators who stay current on the latest technologies. They're always looking for new ways to provide more business value and return on investment while growing their careers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.
  • You have strong experience in relevant skills gained and developed in the same or similar role.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • You'll have a Bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
  • Prior experience that would give you extra comfort in the role includes:
  • .NET Framework - .NET Core
  • C#
  • SQL Server
  • Unit testing
  • EF Core / ORM Frameworks
  • Git
  • Web API development and REST API
  • Microservices
  • TypeScript
  • React.Js
  • Stencil

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer – Cloud Orchestration to lead the design and development of highly scalable, resilient, and secure cloud architectures for our mining technology solutions. This role is key to ensuring orchestration, automation, and optimization of our cloud-based AI, IoT, and data processing workloads.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Architect and develop cloud-native orchestration frameworks for managing large-scale AI, IoT, and industrial applications.
  • Design and implement Kubernetes-based infrastructure with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) for scalability and security.
  • Lead the integration of edge computing and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) to enable real-time data processing and decision-making.
  • Develop high-performance microservices architectures using event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategies with Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi.
  • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery for mission-critical mining applications.
  • Optimize resource allocation and cost efficiency using AI-driven cloud orchestration techniques.
  • Work closely with AI, networking, and data engineering teams to ensure seamless deployment and scalability.
  • Define best practices for security, compliance, and observability (IAM, Zero Trust, SRE principles).
  • Drive CI/CD automation, improving deployment cycles and system reliability.

Key Skills And Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud software engineering, distributed systems, and cloud orchestration.
  • Expertise in Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and container orchestration in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  • Strong programming experience in Golang, Python, or Rust for cloud-native development.
  • Deep knowledge of serverless computing (Lambda, Knative), service mesh (Istio, Consul), and edge computing frameworks.
  • Experience with real-time streaming data processing frameworks (Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, or TensorFlow Serving).
  • Familiarity with 5G, TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking), and IoT networking protocols.
  • Proven experience in multi-cloud security, authentication (OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect), and compliance (ISO 27001, IEC 62443).
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps and SRE principles, including CI/CD pipelines (GitOps, ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in industrial automation, mining, or telecom environments.
  • Knowledge of AI model deployment, optimization, and inference at scale.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud and edge computing strategies.
  • Understanding of decentralized orchestration frameworks is a plus.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Accounting Analyst who is passionate about being involved in a growing business unit!

About the Role

This is a role where you will be a key player in the end-to-end preparation of the financial close of non-technical entities, which is performed based on the locally generally accepted accounting principles (BRGAAP). Additionally, you will be required to search for ways of improving the accounting related processes that are current in place.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Support on the preparation of financial close schedule.
  • Coordinate with all parties involved in the financial close to make sure it is finalized in a reasonable timeframe.
  • Ensure that all accounting entries are BRGAAP compliant.
  • Perform journal entries on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Reconciliation of balance sheet and income statement financial accounts.
  • Provide the management with ad-hoc reports.

About the Team

Finance Brazil is responsible for statutory and regulatory reports for all Swiss Re entities in Brazil, covering local and admitted reinsurers, an insurance company, one service company and one holding company. With more than 30 employees located in São Paulo, the team also provides services for the business team by providing strategics inputs for the development of the company in the country.

About You

You are a great communicator with superior organization, and you compliment your excellent analytical skills with a holistic financial approach.

Must have:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting.
  • At least three years of work experience in financial close activities.
  • Strong analytical skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the insurance industry.
  • CPA certification.
  • Intermediate ability to communicate clearly, read and write in English.

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for people with disabilities in all our positions.

Start your career journey with Swiss Re.

VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO

A Congregação das Irmãs de Santa Marcelina foi fundada pelo Beato Luigi Biraghi em 1838, na Itália, motivado pelos valores éticos, humanitários e cristãos, por meio do amor e do exemplo educador. As Irmãs realizam sua missão nos continentes: americano, europeu e africano, presentes na Albânia, Benin, Brasil, Canadá, Inglaterra, Itália, México e Suíça. No Brasil, atuam em nove estados: Bahia, Brasília, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Tocantins.

Há mais de 60 anos, a Congregação é responsável pelo Santa Marcelina Saúde composto pela rede de 7 hospitais (Porto Velho-RO, Sapezal-MT, Itaquaquecetuba-SP, Cidade Tiradentes-SP, Itaim Paulista-SP, Itaquera-SP e São Bernardo do Campo-SP) e mais de 140 serviços de Atenção Primária à Saúde localizados na região leste do município de São Paulo. Tornou-se uma importante referência na prestação de serviços e pela atuação nos diferentes níveis de atenção à saúde, por meio do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), Convênios e Particulares.

O Analista de Compras de Indiretos será responsável por apoiar o processo de aquisição de bens e serviços necessários para o bom funcionamento da operação da empresa. O profissional atuará em colaboração com diversas áreas da organização, visando garantir o atendimento de necessidades internas com qualidade, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e de acordo com os critérios de custos estabelecidos pela empresa.

  • Gestão de Compras: Realizar o processo de compras de materiais e serviços, como equipamentos de escritório, serviços de manutenção, limpeza, segurança, entre outros.
  • Negociação com Fornecedores: Negociar preços, prazos e condições com fornecedores, buscando sempre as melhores opções que atendam às necessidades da empresa e estejam dentro do orçamento.

  • Compliance e Procedimentos Internos: Garantir que todas as compras sejam realizadas em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos internos da empresa, incluindo a realização de processos de licitação, quando necessário.

  2. Experiência prévia na função de programação, idealmente na indústria de petróleo e gás.
  3. Proficiência no uso de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de programação.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno / Hospital Care
description:
Job description

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união, tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem-estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso à saúde como um todo, e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil, além de fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 6 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.479 leitos, 8.000 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

About Nubank

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world.

Today, Nubank is a global company, with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in São Paulo, by Colombian David Vélez, and co founded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the team

The Talent Acquisition Operations (TA Ops) team enables Nubank’s Talent Acquisition function to scale with consistency, speed, and quality. We operate and evolve the core systems and processes that support hiring while designing solutions that support recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates throughout their journeys. With a strong focus on automation, data quality, and user experience, we work to reduce manual effort and enhance decision-making across the board.

In this role, you’ll also be embedded in Nubank’s Business Automation hub – a central team focused on helping functions across the company become more efficient and scalable. There, you’ll collaborate with technical peers to align on architecture, implementation, and standards, ensuring consistency in what we deliver and supporting your ongoing technical development.

  • Process Analysis and Optimization: Collaborate closely with stakeholders within Talent Acquisition to thoroughly analyze existing business processes. Identify and prioritize opportunities for automation, focusing on areas that can benefit from increased efficiency, accuracy, and cost reduction.
  • Automation Development and Implementation: Leverage your expertise in UiPath and AI technologies to design, develop, and implement robust and scalable automation solutions. This includes building workflows, configuring bots, and integrating AI capabilities like machine learning and natural language processing to handle complex tasks.

Design and maintain seamless data flows between systems, ensuring integration supports efficient processes while upholding data integrity and security across all automation workflows.
  • Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Act as a mentor and guide to less experienced team members. Share your knowledge and expertise, provide guidance on best practices, and foster a collaborative learning environment within the team.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Actively participate in multidisciplinary teams, working closely with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to deliver comprehensive automation solutions that align with business goals and objectives.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Management: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of developed solutions. This includes creating flow diagrams, technical manuals, user guides, and other relevant documentation to ensure knowledge transfer and ease of maintenance.
  • Innovation and Technology Trend Analysis: Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends in automation. Proactively identify and evaluate new tools, techniques, and methodologies that can be leveraged to enhance existing automation or develop innovative solutions.

Estamos à procura de um Consultor SAP BASIS, que será responsável por conduzir a implementação técnica de projetos SAP RISE, administração de sistemas, suporte de ambientes SAP hospedados em RISE, infraestruturas. Como especialista técnico, o consultor lidará com atividades de administração do sistema de ponta a ponta, incluindo implementações do RISE with SAP, cópias do sistema, upgrades, atualizações, automação pós-cópia e configurações de integração. A função requer foco na configuração do sistema gerenciado, configurações de transporte CTS+, conector de nuvem, Web Dispatcher, SSO do aplicativo e do HANA, além do tratamento de certificados. O candidato trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes técnicas e funcionais, a equipe SAP RISE - ECS e os clientes para garantir operações de sistema SAP seguras, eficientes e otimizadas.

Responsibilities and assignments

  1. Planejar e executar implementações do sistema SAP RISE, incluindo atividades pós-HSC (cópia do sistema Hana), atividades de integração ao cenário assim que o RISE entregar o sistema ao cliente;
  2. Executar cópias e atualizações do sistema em diferentes paisagens (S/4 HANA, Gerenciamento de Transporte, PO, SLT), incluindo atividades de pós-cópia e validação;
  3. Configurar e solucionar problemas do SAP Cloud Connector para integração segura da nuvem com o local;
  4. Configurar e manter os sistemas no SLD, concluir a configuração do Sistema Gerenciado no Solution Manager;
  5. Executar atividades de pós-atualização do SAP PO, incluindo configuração, certificados e validações de adaptador;
  6. Configurar e gerenciar o CTS+ para gerenciamento de transporte em ambientes SAP complexos;
  7. Lidar com configurações e manutenção do Web Dispatcher para balanceamento de carga e segurança;
  8. Configurar o Single Sign-On (SSO)/SAML/OAuth e gerenciar certificados digitais em cenários SAP.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Experiência em administração SAP BASIS e HANA com envolvimento em projetos SAP RISE;
  • Experiência prática com cópia e atualização do sistema, incluindo automação pós-cópia;
  • Proficiência na configuração do SAP Cloud Connector, Web Dispatcher, SSO e certificados digitais; forte conhecimento na administração pós-atualização do SAP PO;
  • Experiência com configuração CTS+ e gerenciamento de transporte em cenários multissistemas; familiaridade com SAP Solution Manager;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura SAP, alta disponibilidade e estratégias de recuperação de desastres; inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Formação superior completa;
  • Habilidades técnicas: SAP BASIS, HANA Administration, SAP RISE, System Copy/Refresh, ABAP/JAVA Stack, SAP Cloud Connector, Configuração do Sistema, Pós-Atualização do SAP PO, CTS+, Web Dispatcher, SSO, Certificados, S4 Upgrade.

title: CX Branding Senior Specialist
description:
Why GMF?

GM Financial International Operations conducts business in Latin America and China. International Operations offers a wide range of wholesale and retail automotive financing products to dealers and their customers. The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences and national requirements in local markets. Latin American country operations include Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.

About the role

The Brand Senior Specialist (3F) is responsible for enhancing the brand experience for both internal and external audiences. This involves delivering superior consumer content, maintaining brand identity, and ensuring alignment with GM Financial brands. The specialist optimizes resources, manages budgets, participates in key projects, and collaborates with stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial globally.

Also, drives a customer-centric approach by developing content for key initiatives and executing high-end internal marketing. A crucial part of their role is integrating the Think Customer mind-set into daily operations through continuous engagement and promoting employee empowerment.

The Senior Specialist must set high standards of performance, maintain effectiveness during major changes, have ability to prioritize work, establish plans of execution, and implement an organized work methodology to ensure proper traceability of tasks. Passion for creating positive impacts for customers is essential.

What you need

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Advertising, etc.
  • Performance Standards: Demonstrated ability to set and maintain performance standards across projects, aligning efforts with organizational goals.
  • Project Management: Strong track record in project management, including developing and executing plans that prioritize tasks for timely project completion.
  • Team Leadership: Experience leading multifunctional and/or multicultural teams or individuals without formal authority.
  • Agile Design: Comfort with designing within an agile design lifecycle.
  • Marketing Expertise: Proven experience in marketing, brand implementation, and content creation, with a solid understanding of best practices in internal marketing strategies.
  • Creative Agency Management: Proven experience in managing relationships with creative agencies, overseeing the execution of projects, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, and optimizing the use of allocated budgets.
  • Global Collaboration: Demonstrated global experience, with the ability to effectively collaborate with teams in different countries and navigate cultural nuances.
  • Visual Aesthetics Expertise: Exceptional eye for design and visual aesthetics, with the ability to create visually compelling content that aligns with brand guidelines and enhances audience engagement.
  • Attention to Detail: Detail-oriented with an expert eye for design and visual aesthetics, ensuring all content aligns with brand guidelines and resonates with the target audience.
  • Content Creation: Proficiency in content creation, including the development of content pillars and copywriting, with the ability to craft compelling narratives that engage and inspire audiences.

What you will be doing

  • Brand Governance: Implement the Global Brand Governance accurately across all markets, ensuring alignment with parent brands and involving key stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial.
  • Brand Identity Management: Manage and maintain the brand identity, including the development and enforcement of brand guidelines and assets.
  • Content Creation: Develop and execute content that aligns with the brand identity and resonates with the target audience.
  • Content Oversight: Oversee the creation of high-quality, engaging content across multiple platforms in all markets, ensuring consistency and relevance.
  • Agency and Budget Management: Manage relationships with creative and content agencies, ensuring optimal use of the allocated budget.
  • Asset Management: Develop and maintain up-to-date brand experience assets.
  • Action Plan Execution: Ensure the successful execution of defined action plans, monitoring progress, coordinating with relevant teams and stakeholders, and ensuring tasks are completed on time and within budget.
  • Stakeholder Guidance: Provide guidance and support to stakeholders and vendors for the correct implementation of brand and content strategies.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other functional/departmental managers to ensure full visibility of goals, purposes, and achievements, supporting business requirements.
  • Open Communication: Foster an open communication environment that encourages information sharing, values diverse viewpoints, and seeks input from others.
  • Project Management: Develop comprehensive execution plans for service design projects, setting clear activities, expected outcomes, timelines, and milestones to ensure project success.
  • Performance Standards: Establish clear performance standards for service initiatives, ensuring consistency and quality.
  • Internal Initiatives: Drive the strategic creation and implementation of internal initiatives assigned to the area, supporting the positioning of these initiatives.
  • Think Customer Integration: Integrate the Think Customer initiative into daily operations through continuous engagement, training, and promoting employee empowerment.
  • Strategy Monitoring: Monitor and report on the effectiveness of the implemented brand and content strategies, making necessary adjustments for continuous improvement.

What we offer

At GM Financial we want you to be the most authentic version of yourself. We take care of your work-life balance by programming wellness and integration activities, where you will strengthen your relationships with peers and contribute towards the development and wellbeing of your community, while providing you with a competitive salary and benefits. Some of our global benefits include Extended Maternity & Paternity Leaves, Personal Days & Community Investment hours.

A Paipe é uma empresa com DNA voltado para inovação, tecnologia e transformação digital . Nosso propósito é impulsionar negócios e pessoas por meio de soluções criativas, ágeis e sustentáveis.
Estamos nos preparando para um novo projeto que está em fase de aprovação e, por isso, abrimos este banco de currículos com o objetivo de identificar e nos conectar com profissionais incríveis que tenham interesse em fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente!
Se você é uma pessoa que:

  • Gosta de desafios e ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Tem perfil inovador e colaborativo;
  • Curte tecnologia e busca aprendizado constante;
  • Quer contribuir para construir algo novo desde o início.
Então queremos conhecer você!
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
  • Realizar a instalação inicial do SGBD (Sistema Gerenciador de Banco de Dados), configurando o ambiente para garantir segurança, desempenho e disponibilidade.
  • Configurar e estruturar novos bancos de dados conforme as necessidades do sistema ou da aplicação, definindo parâmetros como espaço em disco, codificação e instâncias.

  • Gerenciar contas de usuários, atribuindo e revogando permissões de acesso, garantindo a segurança e o controle de acessos ao banco.

  • Monitorar e ajustar o uso de espaço físico e lógico do banco de dados, prevenindo falhas por falta de armazenamento e otimizando alocação.
  • Realizar e validar rotinas de backup físico e lógico com uso de ferramentas como RMAN, garantindo a recuperação em caso de falhas.
  • Migrar dados e objetos entre ambientes distintos através de processos de exportação/importação, mantendo a consistência e integridade dos dados.
  • Monitorar a disponibilidade dos serviços de banco de dados e responder prontamente a incidentes ou paradas não planejadas.
  • Atuar na identificação inicial e resolução de falhas ou comportamentos inesperados no ambiente do banco de dados.
  • Analisar e otimizar consultas, índices e estruturas do banco de dados para melhorar a performance das aplicações.
  • Planejar e executar atualizações de versões do SGBD, garantindo compatibilidade, segurança e acesso a novos recursos.

  • Obrigatório Graduação completa na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI);
  • Obrigatório disponibilidade para atuação presencial de segunda á sexta-feira em São Paulo - SP.
  • Júnior: Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência comprovada na área e certificação obrgatória Oracle Certified Associate (OCA) 19c;
  • Pleno: Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência e certificação obrigatória Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) 19c;
  • Sênior: Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência e certificação obrigatória Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) 19c;
  • Conhecimento em Shell Script e PL/SQL;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux;
  • Noções ou experiência com práticas DevOps;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, como Zabbix e Dynatrace;
  • Experiência com utilitários Oracle, incluindo OraTOP, Enterprise Manager, SQL Developer e ASH Viewer.

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
Career Opportunities: Internal Auditor (17611)

World leader on its markets, Vallourec provides benchmark tubular solutions for the energy sector and other highly demanding applications: from oil and gas wells in extreme conditions to state-of-the-art power plants, including bold architectural projects and high-performance mechanical equipment.

In figures, Vallourec is a French industrial group listed on the SBF120 with 16,000 employees and a turnover of 5 billion euros. With a presence in 20 countries, the group operates on all continents.

Vallourec also encompasses 40 production units, 380 researchers and technicians, 4 research and testing centers, and over 45 million euros invested in R&D.

Finally, drawing on its experience in the Oil & Gas sector, Vallourec is preparing for the future by currently developing a comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions that meet the needs of energy transition: carbon capture, hydrogen storage, geothermal energy.

This context makes the environment particularly dynamic and international.

Main missions and activities:

  • Assess the application of procedures and processes by entities, corporate departments and Shared Services Centers throughout the Group.
  • Carry out audit missions (periodic audits or investigation).
  • Prepare recommendations for findings in a report dispatched to the Group managers.

Reporting to the Internal Audit Director, the internal auditor is in charge of:

Periodic audits

  • Preparing and carrying out periodic audits in line with Group methodology.
  • Leading the preparatory phase of the audit to ensure maximum efficiency and to obtain a global understanding of the organization's entity, key events and main areas of risks.

This involves:

  • Preparing audit notifications schedules and agendas.
  • Overseeing the operational phase of the audit: acting as the entity's point of contact.
  • Coordinating data collection (financial data, business review, risk analysis, audit reports,...).
  • Conducting interviews with key managers and all persons involved.
  • Defining audit scope and objectives.
  • Carrying out and supervising tests based on work standards and procedures.
  • Finalizing audit findings and prioritizing recommendations.
  • Monitoring the progress of action plans resulting from the audits carried out, with reference to the timetable established with the entities.
  • Promoting the sharing of best practices between Group entities.
  • Sending a report to the internal control director after the final meeting (report which will then be sent to the entity and to the Vallourec senior managers).

Investigations

The internal auditor could participate in fraud detection and resolution:

  • Prepare and carry out investigations if needed with the internal control director.
  • Propose a relevant methodology and work plan to address specific risks.
  • Coordinate with external support (if any).
  • Write ad hoc reports with recommendations (action plans).

In support of the Director of Internal Audit, the senior internal auditor will also be involved in:

  • Building the annual audit plan.
  • Improving audit methodology (review of work program and best practices).

Notes:

  • Many travels abroad, including long distances needed (USA, Brazil, China, Dubaï...).
  • Corporate position with diversified contacts throughout the Group, worldwide, at all levels (with senior management as well as in mills or with shared service centers).
  • Demonstrate ability to communicate and coordinate with all VLR departments involved. Particularly, ability to write reports mentioning recommendations and being objective.

Requirements:

Experience:

  • Previous experience of internal audit.
  • International experiences (at least as a long term trainee or as a student).

Skills: Autonomy, rigor, dynamic and “agile” mindset, communication skills.

title: Hr business partner senior
description:
Sobre a Olist

A Olist é o sistema operacional do varejo e a parceira número 1 do empreendedor brasileiro.

Oferecemos um universo de possibilidades para potencializar o crescimento de lojistas, com ferramentas conectadas que conversam com as necessidades reais de pequenas e médias empresas (PMEs).

Somos obcecados pelos nossos clientes, e essa paixão nos faz buscar entender continuamente suas dores para transformá-las em soluções que fortaleçam seus negócios e impulsionem suas vidas. Assim, entregamos um ecossistema para gestão do negócio, finanças, integrações, logística, inteligência competitiva de vendas e operações multicanal.

Tudo isso faz de nós um time de alta performance, com profissionais com senso de dono, com muita responsabilidade e proatividade para fazer acontecer.

COMO VOCÊ VAI APOIAR ESSA PARCERIA COM NOSSOS CLIENTES

Seu papel como HR Business Partner na Olist será impulsionar o desempenho das áreas, fortalecendo a liderança, atuando de forma estratégica e orientada por dados.

Esta é uma vaga presencial, em regime CLT e a logística de trabalho é perfeita para quem mora em Curitiba e região.

Suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Influenciar e atuar como parceiro de negócios, contribuindo para um clima favorável ao atingimento dos resultados esperados da área / unidade de negócios que atende;
  • Contribuir para capacitar a liderança em sua responsabilidade na gestão de pessoas dentro de suas equipes, por meio de coaching e/ou orientação em decisões que impactem a experiência do colaborador;
  • Apoiar o desenho organizacional das áreas atendidas de forma consultiva, identificando oportunidades de sinergia, movimentações, novas contratações e ações que garantam o desenvolvimento e a sucessão;
  • Facilitar e acompanhar o fluxo de informações para que a tradução e desdobramento da estratégia aconteça em todas as camadas;
  • Atuar ativamente na construção e manutenção de uma cultura de alta performance, embasada pelos valores e princípios da organização;
  • Mediar situações adversas de crise e conflitos dentro da sua esfera de influência;
  • Atuar de maneira orientada por dados, apoiando em tomadas de decisões baseadas nos principais KPIs de pessoas: Turnover, eNPS e pesquisas de pulso, People Review, Compensation, etc.
  • Fomentar iniciativas de desenvolvimento em conjunto com a área de Talent Management;
  • Contribuir na construção e implementação das ações da agenda institucional de pessoas, como programas de cultura, programas de desenvolvimento, ciclos de avaliação de desempenho, promoção e mérito, e adotando uma postura proativa e analítica em cada ação.
  • Acompanhar tendências do mercado e trazer inovações para a equipe de Pessoas.
  • Apoiar diretamente no onboarding de lideranças, garantindo um processo fluído de adaptação à cultura e modelo de gestão.

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência como BP em áreas / unidades de negócio corporativas e voltadas à geração de resultado;
  • Experiência prévia em outros subsistemas de RH;
  • Vivência em problemas complexos relacionados à gestão de pessoas, gestão de mudanças e/ou cultura organizacional;
  • Entendimento e curiosidade em temas de negócio e estratégia;
  • Formação Superior completa;
  • Inglês nível conversação.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.

COMO SERÁ O PROCESSO?

Assim como na rotina do empreendedor brasileiro, no processo seletivo da Olist você também precisa passar por algumas etapas para alcançar o tão sonhado SIM. Você vai poder transformar a maneira de fazer comércio junto com a gente ao passar pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Inscrição;
  • Entrevista com time de Gente & Gestão;
  • Entrevista com pares do time;
  • Entrevista final com a liderança.

E pra que você possa se organizar, o nosso processo seletivo é remoto. Caso seja necessário alguma conversa presencial, vamos avisar com antecedência.

BENEFÍCIOS FLEXÍVEIS PARA VOCÊ ESCOLHER

Já imaginou decidir o quanto do seu benefício você vai gastar em alimentação, gasolina, farmácia e muitas outras categorias? Aqui, na Olist, isso é totalmente possível. Sabemos que cada pessoa tem gostos e necessidades diferentes, por isso oferecemos benefícios flexíveis. Com eles, você escolhe onde investir seu dinheiro! Conheça alguns deles:

  • Vale-Refeição e Vale-Alimentação (Cartão Caju);

  5. Collaboration and Support: Work with development and QA teams to manage application lifecycle. Document processes and workflows for knowledge sharing.

  • Experience with Kubernetes in production, including deployment and scaling.

title: Senior Sales Analyst
description:
Who we are -

We are web-based video-on-demand networks with a focus on adult entertainment, based out of Downtown Miami. We are a group of creative souls with diverse backgrounds. If you are also a true believer of work hard & play hard, this is the place to be. At PSM, you will enjoy a fun & casual environment, team-building retreats, startup spirits, and great benefits.

What we do -

We discover what excites the world and deliver it seamlessly to our members! We are the creators of top sites you know and love. We are leading the industry by using cutting-edge technologies to deliver top-quality content. Our content and websites are published exclusively and enjoyed by millions of fans worldwide.

What we are looking for -

Paper Street Media, LLC is hiring for a FULL-TIME Senior Sales Analyst. The primary role of the Senior Sales Analyst is to have strong technical skills in data analysis combined with a deep business understanding to support strategic decision-making. This role requires experience in SQL, data visualization (especially with Google Looker), and translating data into actionable insights for non-technical users, including company executives.

The job will expose you to the content of adult nature. If this is something you are not comfortable with please do not apply.

We will contact you via email only. We will not contact you via phone calls or any 3rd party messaging system. Please be aware of any job offer scam.

The job will start on a 90-day probationary period.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Generate complex queries in our Data Warehouse using advanced SQL skills, extracting key insights on sales performance and subscriptions.
  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards in Google Looker to monitor sales performance, subscription trends, churn rates, and customer behavior.
  • Generate both high-level and detailed presentations to provide actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to understand analytical needs, identify opportunities, and provide data-driven support.
  • Effectively communicate with non-technical users, including executives, translating complex data into clear business strategies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and measure key performance indicators (KPIs) in sales, customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.
  • Utilize JIRA to track and manage tasks related to sales analysis and reporting.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Must Haves:

  • More than 5 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant work experience may be accepted in place of a degree.
  • Proven experience in SQL for data extraction and analysis in Data Warehouse environments.
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
  • Experience in generating reports and data visualizations using Google Looker.
  • Familiarity with JIRA or similar task management tools.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with non-technical users and present analytical insights clearly and strategically.
  • High attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
  • Experience in creating executive presentations and reports.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with Python for advanced analysis and data modeling.
  • Familiarity with customer segmentation techniques and predictive analytics for sales forecasting.
  • Experience in conveying insights and delivering presentations to non-technical users, with a business-focused approach.
  • Experience analyzing financial systems and sales operations.
  • Prior knowledge of subscription-based systems and online business models.
  • Desire to improve business performance through discovery analysis.
  • Ability to spot outliers, anomalies, and trends by analyzing various datasets.

Nice To Haves:

  • Experience with the adult entertainment industry or film production industry.
  • Intermediate level of Spanish.

title: GERENTE DE ARQUITETURA
description:
O Banco ABC Brasil S.A é um banco múltiplo, autorizado pelo Banco Central a praticar operações ativas, passivas e acessórias relacionadas às suas carteiras (comercial, de investimento, de crédito, financiamento e investimento, e de crédito imobiliário), incluindo câmbio.

Fundado em 1989 através de uma joint-venture entre o Arab Banking Corporation e o Grupo Roberto Marinho, originando o Banco ABC Roma S.A., focado em crédito corporativo e tesouraria, o banco consolidou uma base sólida de clientes no segmento Corporate, oferecendo produtos financeiros de alto valor agregado. Em 1991, assumiu a atual administração com executivos brasileiros experientes, e em 1997, o Arab Banking Corporation adquiriu participação do Grupo Roberto Marinho, tornando-se o acionista controlador. Os executivos adquiriram participação minoritária, alinhando interesses ao controlador, e o banco passou a se chamar Banco ABC Brasil S.A.

Em 2007, realizou sua oferta pública inicial de ações e passou a integrar o Nível 2 de governança corporativa da BM&FBovespa.

Além de soluções para empresas, oferece um portfólio de investimentos para pessoas físicas, por meio do ABC Personal. Destaca-se por possuir controle internacional e autonomia local.

O Banco ABC Brasil valoriza talentos e oferece um ambiente de oportunidades de carreira e desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades do cargo

  1. Liderar a evangelização do capítulo Arquitetura junto aos engenheiros, garantindo entregas de soluções técnicas inovadoras e de alta qualidade.
  2. Fornecer orientação técnica e atuar como mentor para Tech Managers, Tech Leads e Staff Engineers.
  3. Assegurar que os direcionamentos, padrões e ADRs estejam sendo seguidos, avaliando maturidade e aderência.
  4. Evoluir as Arquiteturas de Referência, padrões, ferramentas e frameworks.
  5. Comunicar ideias complexas de forma clara, promovendo colaboração.
  6. Introduzir novas ideias para melhorias alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio, documentando arquiteturas e visões.
  7. Influenciar a direção técnica e contribuir para o sucesso a longo prazo.
  8. Melhorar eficiência e qualidade, garantindo conformidade com boas práticas.
  9. Representar o banco em eventos e comunidades técnicas, fortalecendo sua reputação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência liderando equipes de Engenharia/Arquitetura, preferencialmente com background técnico em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo avaliação de desempenho e crescimento de carreira.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, cerimônias, métricas e processos.
  • Profundo entendimento técnico para participação em discussões de arquitetura e construção de visões corporativas.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia como desenvolvedor, tech lead, tech manager ou arquiteto.
  • Conhecimento em múltiplas linguagens de programação e frameworks.
  • Domínio de Design Patterns, SOLID, Clean Code, entre outros.
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura de Software e estilos arquiteturais.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL e relacionais.
  • Familiaridade com protocolos RESTful, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket.
  • Conhecimento em segurança cibernética, computação distribuída, cloud computing, DevSecOps, orquestração de containers, observabilidade e qualidade de software.

Benefícios adicionais

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica.
  • Programa ABC com Você.
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação.
  • Licença Paternidade e Maternidade estendidas.
  • Auxílio Home Office e Infraestrutura.

Somos o ABC Brasil, um banco com mais de 35 anos de história, focado em soluções financeiras, combinando solidez internacional com gestão local ágil. Nosso compromisso é gerar impacto real, evoluindo com o mercado, sempre com responsabilidade, integridade e confiança. Valorizamos conexões verdadeiras, respeito às diferenças e um ambiente colaborativo, humano e inspirador, onde cada pessoa pode crescer com autonomia e protagonismo.
